stem: One reason this provision was included in the Treaty of Versailles was to —

options.label: F
options.text: create a democratic government in Germany

options.label: G
options.text: divide Germany into smaller states to be governed by Allied countries

options.label: H
options.text: grant independence to all German colonies

options.label: J
options.text: weaken the power of Germany in the international community

visual_elements: The Allied and Associated Governments, however, require, and Germany undertakes, that she will make compensation for all damage done to the civilian population of the Allied and Associated Powers and to their property during the period of the belligerency of each as an Allied or Associated Power against Germany. —The Treaty of Versailles, Article 232, June 1919
